look_here_first: Look for tall clonal stems with broad opposite leaves, then dense rounded axillary umbels and individual five-hooded flowers; do not use pink color alone.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: tall rhizomatous perennial with milky latex

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: broad opposite elliptic-ovate leaves, often pale and hairy beneath

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: inflated follicles often with soft tubercles
